note: An AEA PK-232 (MRPT ON): the source first, the destination last, the digipeaters between, the star on the station heard; heard direct, the two-line form (HEADERLN ON), a stamped I frame passed over, and a made-up APRS line in the same form.
source: PK-232 manual Rev G, 4.6.11.2, MRPT, MSTAMP; the last line made up
